title: Smale's 12th Problem: Centralizers of Diffeomorphisms
exact_target: Do diffeomorphisms whose only commuting diffeomorphisms are their own iterates form a dense set, a residual set, or a set containing an open dense subset, in each differentiability class?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 64 (SMA-012). CC BY 4.0.

Christian Bonatti, Sylvain Crovisier and Amie Wilkinson, The C1 Generic Diffeomorphism Has Trivial Centralizer, Publications Mathématiques de l’IHÉS 109 (2009), 185--244; arXiv:0804.1416, Section 1.1, Question 1 and the following C1 results, pages 3--4.
